# Zubair MeatFlow

> Zubair MeatFlow is a poultry and meat supply management ERP for distributors — farms, shops, POS, ledgers, deliveries, and recovery tracking, with English and Urdu support.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/auth): Authorized sign-in page for tenants of Zubair MeatFlow.
- [Trust & Security](/trust): Overview of security, privacy, and platform controls.

## Optional

- [Home](/): Authenticated dashboard (requires sign-in).
